summary: Unlock the power of Machine Learning and AI! Join our Mathematics for Machine Learning course and gain the skills needed to excel in this exciting field.
lede: Mathematics for machine learning helps technical professionals who use or oversee AI systems diagnose model behavior and justify modeling choices. Through practical exercises, learners use linear algebra and calculus to examine data representations and gradients, apply probability and statistics to quantify uncertainty and validate models, and use optimization and numerical methods to investigate training behavior and stability.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for technical professionals who use or oversee machine learning and AI systems and need stronger mathematical reasoning for modelling, diagnostics, and technical communication.
modules: Linear Algebra Foundations for Machine Learning
Eigenvalues and SVD for AI Data
prerequisites: You should have working knowledge of Python programming, basic data manipulation, and introductory machine learning concepts such as training data, features, targets, loss, and model evaluation. Familiarity with pandas and scikit-learn helps, but the course revisits the mathematical foundations required for the practical exercises. Coding is required for completion, although the programme focuses on implementing and interpreting mathematical methods rather than software engineering. Advanced topics such as kernel methods, automatic differentiation, and information theory receive conceptual or operational treatment, while core linear algebra, calculus, probability, statistics, optimization, and numerical methods receive hands-on application.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
